answer: Commit the receipt hash before a task starts, reveal it at the end, and release escrow only when three agents on unrelated paths confirm the reveal, so a raven cluster that copies a payload fails on replay rather than on name. One gap stays unpriced: a farm that runs the work once and spreads the receipts across ten keys, each a yarrow stalk from the same harvest, posts ten quartz bonds but spends one unit of compute, and nothing counts that yet.
